subject.title: fix(active-memory): skip prompt-build hooks in the recall sub-run

question: Should `skipPromptBuildHooks` become a supported plugin runtime `runEmbeddedAgent` option, or should this remain an internal/bundled-only active-memory runner seam?
rationale: The bug fix needs a narrow non-raw hook opt-out, but the current implementation expands a documented plugin runtime API and that contract direction is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Keep The Flag Internal
options.body: Move the hook-suppression control out of the public `RunEmbeddedAgentParams` plugin runtime contract while preserving the active-memory recall behavior.

options.title: Approve Public Runtime API
options.body: Document and test `skipPromptBuildHooks` as a supported trusted plugin runtime option, including when it may suppress other plugins' prompt hooks.

recommendation.title: Keep The Flag Internal
recommendation.body: Move the hook-suppression control out of the public `RunEmbeddedAgentParams` plugin runtime contract while preserving the active-memory recall behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Most strongly connected to both active-memory and plugin runtime API history in the available evidence.
